products.name: Graco Pack 'n Play Portable Playard with Push Button Compact Fold
products.query: Graco Pack 'n Play Portable Playard Push Button Compact Fold Carnival
products.summary: A full-size playard whose push-button fold, folding feet and wheels make it easy to collapse and roll away between uses. Graco says the fold is 20% more compact than the average playard.
products.renterNote: Suits a parent who needs the playard up for play and down for sleep or storage in a one-room apartment. Caveat: it is the bulkiest of the three when set up (Graco lists 39.5 in deep x 28.25 in wide x 29 in high) and Graco publishes no folded dimensions.
pros: Push-button fold with folding feet and wheels, per Graco
Ranked first in the Small Space Baby compact-playpen guide (8.3/10)
cons: Bulky once set up, per one retailer reviewer
Weighs about 18.7 lb per Graco; no folded size published
products.scoreNote: Scores are editorial judgments from manufacturer specs and guide write-ups, not hands-on tests. Folds and rolls, but weight and set-up footprint are larger than the other picks.

products.name: Dream On Me Nest Portable Playard
products.query: Dream On Me Nest Portable Playard
products.matchName: Dream On Me Nest Portable Playard
products.badge: Best smallest footprint for sleep and play
products.summary: A travel-style playard with mesh sides, a removable padded mat and a quick-fold frame, listed at about 40 x 28 inches. Guides pitch it for bedrooms, guest rooms and shared rooms.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter with a small bedroom or a family that moves the playard between rooms. Caveat: it is a smaller sleep-and-play space for infants, not a roomy toddler pen, and sources disagree on its height (24 vs 27.5 in).
pros: About 40 x 28 in footprint, per Dream On Me and retailer listings
Weighs about 16.85 lb and comes with a carry bag
cons: Little room for a mobile toddler
Listings disagree on assembled height; one retailer lists the folded size as 7 x 7.5 x 28 in and no other source confirms it
products.scoreNote: Editorial judgment from maker and retailer specs; no independent hands-on review was found.

products.name: Fodoss Baby Playpen with Mat 47x47
products.query: Fodoss baby playpen with mat 47x47 inch
products.badge: Best for a crawler's play area
products.summary: A square 47 x 47 inch panel playpen with mesh sides, a zipper door and a mat, built for floor play rather than travel. Guides pick it for apartments and corners.
products.renterNote: Suits a parent who wants a defined play area in a living room and can leave it up. Caveat: it needs about 4 ft x 4 ft of floor and is not portable once assembled.
pros: Mesh sides, pull rings and tool-free assembly (about 20 minutes), per roundups
Suction cups help it stay put on hard floors, per one roundup
cons: Roundups note thin padding and some quality inconsistency
products.scoreNote: Editorial judgment from guide write-ups; floor-hugging and not folding, so it takes the most permanent floor space.
